🔹 Direct access to book details by tapping its cover in Activity. 🔹 Option to follow users directly from reviews. 🔹 It is now possible to reply and like ActivityPub posts. 🔹 Reviews are sorted from newest to oldest. 🔹 Fixed the bug when publishing reviews and follower counters. 🔹 Internal stability improvements and reduced battery consumption.

Expanded search: It is now possible to search for users and locate books hosted on other instances.
Comfortable reading: New \"…read more\" button to expand long reviews in the activity section.
Counter fix: Solved the bug that showed 0 followers/following.
Compatibility: Improved synchronization with Mastodon accounts.
Design: Added support for monochrome icons.
It is on your Read shelf now. You can write a review and give it stars, or leave it as it is.

Quotes and reviews: You can now view them integrated directly into each book's details page.

Polished search: Improved interface text and internal adjustments to make search more precise.

New languages: The app is now available in Catalan and Ukrainian, and includes fixes for Finnish.

Stability: Internal code improvements (ProGuard/Gson) to prevent runtime crashes.

Quotes: Improved visual design and fixed the bug that duplicated the quote text.

Compatibility: Updated support to work properly with BookWyrm servers on version 0.8.

Counters: Fixed the calculation of the number of followers and following.

- Connection error fix: Fixed the bug (Error 307) that prevented performing actions due to HTTPS redirection problems when logging in. It is no longer necessary to log in again.
- Followers counter: Fixed the problem on servers with BookWyrm 0.8 that showed your followers and following as 0. The app now calculates this number internally to avoid the server bug.

New Notifications tab: You can now check all your notices and alerts directly from the new section in the bottom bar.

Dark Mode improvements: The app's loading screen and login now respect your phone's dark theme. No more bright flashes when opening the app at night!

Polished visualization: Design adjustments to make reading activities more comfortable.

Share reviews: You can now easily send the reviews you read to other apps.
Reading goals: You can now view your goals directly from your profile screen.
Search fix: Fixed the bug that prevented opening book details after searching.

Login fix: Resolved an issue that prevented loading shelves correctly when logging in using a full handle (e.g. user@instance.com).

Stability: Improved server response parsing to prevent crashes due to invisible characters (BOM).

⚠️ Important: If your BookWyrm instance uses Cloudflare, you might occasionally experience connection errors. We are currently investigating a solution for this.

Performance: All lists (activity, books, notifications) are now much smoother and faster.

Design: Refreshed color palette with a vibrant blue and new rounded corners.

Stability: Fixed crashes caused by invisible characters (BOM) in server responses.

⚠️ Important: Due to technical limitations, if your BookWyrm instance (like ramblingreaders.org) uses Cloudflare security checks, the application will not be able to connect.

- Boost button: Added the option to boost posts to share them directly on your activity timeline.\n\n- Reviews and quotes: You can now read community reviews and quotes directly from each book\'s details page.
What\'s new in version 1.1.3: * **Notifications:** Fixed list rendering and added support for viewing full content when tapping on them.
What\'s new in version 1.1.5:\n* **Bug fixes:** Fixed a compatibility issue that caused the app to crash on Android 14 and older devices when viewing notifications.

WHAT'S NEW
• Reading Progress: The current reading progress is now displayed directly on the book's details page.
• Production Readiness: Internal adjustments and final configuration for the official launch of the application on the Google Play Store.

FIXES
• Fixed the bug that prevented reading progress from updating correctly (resolved technical issue with CSRF Referer).

Special thanks to @HBB for their contribution to this update!

WHAT'S NEW
• Danish Language: Added support for Danish.
• Translation Improvements: Extracted hardcoded Spanish texts and completed missing translations across all languages.

FIXES
• Search State: Preserved the search state when rotating the screen.
• ISBN Detection: Refactored and improved ISBN detection logic.
• Login/OkHttp: Unified the User-Agent between OkHttp and the login WebView.
• Scraper Markers: Removed hardcoded Spanish markers from the scraper.

Special thanks to @HBB for all their incredible contributions to this release!

WHAT\'S NEW\n• Finish reading: You can now mark a book as finished directly from its details or your profile. This action will close the reading session and add the book to your reading goal (just like on the Bookwyrm website).

WHAT'S NEW
• Book detail page: The book detail view is now a full-screen page with tabs (Summary, Reviews, and Details) instead of a pop-up dialog. The back button returns to the previous list without losing your scroll position.
• Enhanced shelves: Book cards now show author, user rating (with half stars), number of pages, language (as a flag), and reading dates. Data is fetched once and cached locally.
• Shelf sorting: You can now sort your shelves by title (A–Z / Z–A), by finish date (newest/oldest), and by rating (highest/lowest).

FIXES
• Scraping: Fixed three bugs that prevented fetching quotes, updating reading progress, and displaying some book covers.
• Shelf display: Fixed a bug that caused duplicate books when sorting or paginating shelves.
• Translations: Completed all missing translations across the 16 supported languages.

Special thanks to @HBB for their outstanding contributions to this release!

WHAT'S NEW
• Customizable profile: You can now reorder and hide the different sections of your profile to your liking. The order is saved on the device and changes are applied only when you press "Save".
• Reading statistics: Added a new card on the profile with charts and key figures: total books read and this year, accumulated pages, and a bar chart with the history of books per year.
• Reading pace: The annual challenge card now indicates if you are ahead or behind your goal based on the current day. It also shows your average days taken to read a book (this year and in total).
• New charts on the profile: Most read authors, ratings breakdown, and languages and formats of the books you read (automatically detected from shelves).
• "To Read" shelf: Added a quick access row on the profile with the covers of the books from your "To Read" shelf.
• Translations completed: Translated all profile strings (including plural rules) to the 17 languages supported by the application.

FIXES AND INTERNAL IMPROVEMENTS
• Notifications: Fixed a silent error (403 CSRF) that prevented the "Clear all notifications" button from actually working on the server. An error message is now displayed if the operation fails.
• Shelves cache: Fixed an issue where only the first page of the shelf was saved when using the app offline. Now the entire shelf is cached when scrolling through it.
• Shared stars: The rating stars component (RatingStars) has been refactored to reuse it throughout the app consistently, and the obsolete half-star icon has been replaced with its correct version for RTL reading.

WHAT'S NEW
• **Lightning-fast book details:** It now opens instantly (even offline) by recovering the last saved information from the local cache while updating in the background.
• **All book info at a glance:** The detail screen now shows the subtitle, series, and its number in it. The details tab centralizes and displays all available information (format, equivalent printed pages for ebooks, publisher, ISBN, reading dates, rereads, etc.).
• **Agile management from the detail screen:** New menu with one button per shelf (instead of indented options), without an unnecessary confirmation step. You can now remove a book from a shelf and quickly add searched books to your shelves.
• **Full control of your reading:** You can edit your reading dates directly from the detail screen and log your progress in "ebook pages" (with an automatic converter to the percentage required by the server). The main action (Start reading, Update progress) is now always visible at the bottom, regardless of the selected tab.
• **Editions Management:** If you saved the book in a different language, the detail screen now warns you which edition you have on your shelf and allows you to directly choose another edition of the work from a specific dialog (with language filter).
• **Search in your shelves:** The main search filters your own shelves locally as you type, showing an indicator. Tapping a result from your library will jump directly to that shelf and highlight the book.
• **Barcode scanner:** Added a new feature to search for books by scanning their barcode.
• **Profile Statistics:** Added a new swipeable section (block) in the profile with "Highest rated books", sorted by rating and date.
• **Improved navigation:** Tapping the "My books" icon while already on that tab returns you to the root menu (the list of shelves). In "Read", you can now group your reads by Series.

FIXES
• **BookWyrm v0.80 compatibility:** Fixed (404) errors that prevented posting comments, reviews, or quotes, updating read pages, marking books as finished, or moving books between shelves on instances updated to version 0.80.
• **Network Performance:** Drastically reduced requests (from 5 to 1) when opening a book detail screen by following automatic redirects and reusing components.
• **Infinite shelves:** Fixed the issue where the shelf would enter a loop requesting the same page repeatedly (causing freezes or unexpected crashes), or data loading would stop when opening a book prematurely during pagination.
• **List rendering:** The shelf screen will no longer shrink suddenly during refresh. Additionally, when jumping to a book from the search engine, the screen will no longer vibrate repositioning the book while the next pages load.
• **Clear error texts:** Translated indecipherable technical errors ("timeout", "502") into readable sentences with suggestions on how to proceed or what to expect from your connection / the server.
• **Exact rounding:** The average rating is now exactly rounded to a half-star.
• Fixed the unexpected crash on the Activity screen.

Fixes and Improvements
• BookWyrm 0.8+ compatibility: Permanently fixed 404 errors when moving books between shelves, updating reading progress, adding dates or posting reviews.
• Editions management: The application now uses the exact edition identifier of the book instead of the general work. This fixes failures when creating or logging reading sessions.
• Network optimization: Repeated internal downloads have been eliminated. The app now makes better use of the cache when querying or updating book data, reducing data consumption and improving speed.

What's New
• Optional rating: When marking a book as finished, writing a review is no longer mandatory. A dialog lets you choose "Review" or "Not now".
• Group by author: In the "Read" shelf, you can now group and filter books by author.
• Fix incomplete books from profile: If books are missing pages or authors, a profile alert takes you to an interactive list to fix them.
• "Stopped reading" shelf: Now visible by default in "My books".
• Shelves customization: Sort, hide, and align shelves in "My books" via "Edit page".
• Explore improvements (Open Library): New stackable filters and integrated search with suggestions.
• Revamped search: Redesigned interface and relocated barcode scanner.
• Accessible changelog: Read the changelog anytime from notifications.

Fixes and Improvements
• Intuitive navigation: Back button now undoes actions step-by-step.
• Simplified reading actions: Actions unified in the bottom bar.
• Cover display: Dynamic calculation of covers based on screen width.
• Multilingualism: Thoroughly reviewed translations.
• Version differentiation: Development builds now named "Rocinante debug".
